from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the judgment document (e.g., '刑事申诉审查通知书', '民事二审判决书')")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="The broad legal category of the case (e.g., '刑事', '民事', '行政')")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific legal cause of action or crime name mentioned in the document (e.g., '危险驾驶罪', '公司解散纠纷')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgment_documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
